title: SecondaryTelephonyProvider - Tooling API
description: Represents the SIP configuration for secondary telephony providers in Agentforce Contact Center Bring Your Own Carrier (BYOC). This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

DeveloperName.description: Unique name of the object in the API.

InboundAuthEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
InboundAuthEnabled.description: Indicates whether inbound authentication is enabled (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

InboundIpAllowlist.description: Allowed inbound caller ID configurations used to process incoming calls from the secondary telephony provider.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

MasterLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
MasterLabel.description: User interface label for the secondary telephony provider. This internal label doesn’t get translated.

TelephonyProviderId.description: ID of the associated telephony provider. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access SecondaryTelephonyProvider, you must have the Agentforce Contact Center Admin (Salesforce Voice) permission set assigned.
